tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search companies by name in official business registers: France (INSEE Sirene / RNE), Norway (Brønnøysund), Finland (PRH/YTJ) and US SEC EDGAR filers. Returns normalized records (registry id, legal name, legal form, status, incorporation date, address, industry code, website, VAT where published).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Look up one company by its official identifier: FR SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14), NO organisasjonsnummer (9 digits), FI Y-tunnus (1234567-8), US CIK or stock ticker.
